scope: P1-A65 complete classic Han Dang, Gongqi and Jiefan runtime, AI, WPF presentation and official portrait
selectedVersion: 一将成名官网经典韩当（吴4体力，弓骑、解烦）

sources.use: 一将成名官方武将页冻结经典韩当、弓骑和解烦文本，并提供经典静态大图入口。
三国杀 OL 官方韩当页用于核对武将身份、势力与技能名称。
官方历史攻略用于交叉核对经典弓骑与解烦的实际选择流程。
官方调整公告明确列出调整前技能文本，用于排除后续改版并锁定本包采用的经典版本。

ruleText.gongqi: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以弃置一张牌使你本回合的攻击范围无限。若弃置的为装备牌，你可以弃置一名其他角色的一张牌。
ruleText.jiefan: 限定技，出牌阶段，你可以选择一名角色，令能攻击到该角色的所有角色选择一项：1.弃置一张武器牌；2.令该角色摸一张牌。

implementation.gongqiInteraction: one exact owned hand or equipment card is discarded; the turn-scoped range usage is consumed immediately; an equipment-category cost publishes one private optional target-card prompt with opaque hand slots, public equipment and skip
implementation.jiefanInteraction: the game-scoped limited use is consumed at declaration; every living non-beneficiary currently able to attack the beneficiary is frozen in owner-relative seat order and must either discard an equipped weapon or let the beneficiary draw one card
implementation.aiPolicy: Gongqi target-card continuation uses only public relationship, target and equipment information while hand slots stay opaque; Jiefan responses compare public relationship against the public weapon cost

versionBoundary.replayPolicy: accepted commands reconstruct paused Gongqi opaque-card selection, paused Jiefan responder choices, turn/game usage ledgers, movements and completed event history under rules v101
versionBoundary.legacyPolicy: package 1.92.0 retains the complete Cheng Pu roster without Han Dang; package signature and content hash provide the new-content boundary

portrait.attribution: Official classic Han Dang artwork reused only for the user's local experiment under explicit authorization

acceptance.visualReview: 216 through 218 at 1120x740 inspected: card, private Gongqi card selection and mandatory Jiefan response are readable without clipping or overlap
assertions: package 1.93.0 publishes complete Han Dang while package 1.92.0 retains its prior content boundary
Gongqi recognizes equipment cards from hand or equipment, grants unlimited range immediately and exposes other hands only as opaque slots
Jiefan freezes responders using activation-time distance and range, excludes the beneficiary and consumes its game-limited use
Gongqi unlimited range can add Han Dang to Jiefan's frozen responder set
paused and completed continuations replay with exact movements, events and legal actions
WPF exposes both metadata axes, private choices, target context and public battle cues
